entities.name: Tahirid Sultanate
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Tahirid Sultanate or Tahirid dynasty were a Muslim dynasty that ruled Yemen from 1454 to 1517. They succeeded the Rasulid Dynasty and were themselves replaced by the Mamluks of Egypt after only 63 years in power.
